hero.title: From field operations to management visibility
hero.subtitle: We build practical solutions that help organisations gain control, visibility, and performance in critical areas — with a sharp focus on efficiency, safety, and better-informed decisions. We work alongside operations, maintenance, and leadership teams to turn data and processes into actions that cut losses, strengthen reliability, and sustain clearer decisions across the industrial day-to-day.

about.title: About us
about.intro: We are a consulting firm focused on technology and operational improvement in demanding industrial environments — bringing field presence and management perspective together.
paragraphs: Jatoba Consulting and Technology helps organisations align plant realities with board-level needs. We combine hands-on operations and maintenance experience with data, metrics, and process governance to reduce uncertainty and speed up improvement.

We know business upside can turn into exposure when clarity, reliable visibility, and execution discipline are missing. That is why we work from workflow and instrumentation design through KPI cadence and team readiness to sustain gains over time.

We assemble workstreams with profiles that match each challenge — from asset reliability to materials and workforce performance — helping your operation gain predictability and sustainable performance.

testimonial.title: Testimonial
testimonial.intro: Notes from a recent engagement on operational improvement and management visibility.
testimonial.quote: Jatoba helped us organise how we read operations and prioritise what truly moved availability and cost. The approach is technical, pragmatic, and aligned with what leadership needs to decide.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.p1: This policy describes how the Jatoba Consulting and Technology (“Jatoba”) institutional website may process personal information provided by visitors, in line with applicable law and sound practice.
privacyPage.p2: When you use contact forms or e-mail channels, you may provide details such as your name, company, phone number, and e-mail address. We use this information solely to respond to enquiries and pursue legitimate business discussions about Jatoba services.
privacyPage.p3: Jatoba applies reasonable safeguards to protect information from unauthorised access or misuse. We do not sell personal data to third parties. Technology providers involved in hosting or transactional mail may receive strictly limited technical access under appropriate contracts and confidentiality duties.
privacyPage.p4: Where applicable, you may ask to correct or delete contact details submitted via this website by reaching out through the Contact section.
privacyPage.p5: Cookies and similar technologies may be used only for site functionality or aggregated audience analytics; further detail can be reflected here once the final technical setup is confirmed.
